description: Access to notifications, with the unread count and read actions.

howToUse: Use it in the top bar to show what is new for the person, with the count of unread items on the bell.
Pass the `items` from your server. Open the related page in `onItemClick` and mark everything read in `onMarkAllRead`, updating the items and the count.
Set `emptyMessage` for when there is nothing new.
alternatives: The result of an action just taken: Toast.
A full history of what happened: ActivityTimeline.

keyboard.action: Opens the panel and moves focus into it.
Moves through the notifications and the panel actions.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the bell.
